title: FinTok
tagline: FinTok is an open-source, DeFi Trading robot that captures users stake to make outstanding returns.
description:
FinTok Core Features:
🌍 World’s First Decentralized Trading Robot.
📈 Dedicated Trading Agent, Customizable by user.
📜 Custom Contract Runner.
🧱 App is compatible with all EVM supported chains, deployed on Sepolia Testnet.
✅ Contract Hot Reload: Your frontend auto-adapts to your smart contract as you edit it. 
🔥 Burner Wallet & Local Faucet: Quickly test your application with a burner wallet and local faucet or test with any live or testnet EVM chain. 

The aim of FinTok is to provide the average DeFi user with market leading strategies, giving them a higher yield on assets. This is achieved by using state-of-the-art machine learning models. Combining these with staking protocols, our users can expect larger returns compared to traditional staking methods.
how_its_made:
FinTok is built with a Next.js frontend and a Python Backend. FinTok utilized 3 different partner technologies, including Chainlink, Uniswap and Scroll.

FinTok utilizes Open Zeppelin's audited Staking Contracts enabling users to deposit ETH or USDC for trading. Users can therefore withdraw staked assets with added security.
